terms.grammar: ablative absolute with abesse: “to be away from school, the parents not knowing”
terms.comment: Traupman’s phrase, built of classical words: īnscius, not knowing, and abesse, to be away.

sources: Lewis & Short: inscius · Lewis & Short: absum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 30, 31, checked against the searchable text of the book.
